The '''Mason''' is a [[villager]] profession that sells building stone as [[bulk blocks]]. Its job site block is the [[Stonecutter]]. Every mason trade gives bulk blocks, each of which unpacks into 64 blocks, so one [[Obol]] buys between 64 and 384 blocks. It buys nothing.

All trades can be used 999 times before restocking, and every level offers all of its trades.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/trade_set/mason/level_1.json}}</ref> The mason has no Master trades.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/5/filler.json}}</ref>

A bulk block is used like food, instantly: using it replaces it with 64 of its block, which go straight into the inventory. See [[Bulk blocks]] for details.

Like every villager, a mason that has been traded with also buys its [[favorite food]] once.

== Issues ==
* Six of the bulk blocks (terracotta, malachite, cinnabar, blackstone, smooth basalt and smooth quartz) have no entry in the language file, so in game their name and tooltip show as raw keys such as <code>item.kleispack.trade.bulk_terracotta</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/2/terracotta.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The data pack contains an unused Expert trade file, <code>mason/4/quartz_emerald</code>, which is a discarded placeholder and is not in the Expert trade list.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/4/quartz_emerald.json}}</ref>
